en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European riverside town with a large bridge crossing the river in the foreground. On a hill above the town stands a vast castle‑like complex and a Gothic cathedral with multiple tall spires. Traditional buildings fill the lower town, and blossoming tree branches frame the right side of the image. Caption text is printed along the bottom margin.
